id: 13_Clean and Organized is Laser Safety Wise Laser Maintenance Group Innovative Lase
title: 整洁有序也是安全
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/13_Clean and Organized is Laser Safety Wise Laser Maintenance Group Innovative Lase.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/13_Clean and Organized is Laser Safety Wise Laser Maintenance Group Innovative Lase/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着扫帚站在整洁的激光加工车间里
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a broom in a neat and tidy laser workshop.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：整洁有序也是安全。

shots.scene: 通道、线缆、废料桶、格栅台、废料架五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a clear walkway, a cable, a scrap bucket, a slatted cutting table, and a scrap rack. No people.
shots.narration: 通道、线缆、废料，一样样理清。

shots.scene: 阿杰边走边抬头看激光切割机，没注意脚下的电线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks while staring up at a laser cutting machine, not noticing a cable lying across the floor.
shots.narration: 阿杰边走边看机器，没看脚下。

shots.scene: 阿杰被电线绊了一下，差点撞上伸出来的废料
shots.prompt_en: The young male student trips on the cable and almost bumps into sharp metal scraps sticking out of a bucket.
shots.narration: 一绊，差点撞上伸出来的废料尖角。

shots.scene: 小研扶住他，指着地上的电线和废料桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steadies him and points at the cable and the scrap bucket.
shots.narration: 小研扶住他：这些东西不该在这儿。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 乱，本身就是隐患。

shots.scene: 王老师在车间门口带着访客，指着整洁的通道
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at the workshop door with visitors and points to a clean walkway.
shots.narration: 带人进车间，就要替他们想着安全。

shots.scene: 激光图标旁加一个扫帚图标，中间画等号连到盾牌
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a laser plus a broom icon, joined by an equals sign to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 整理整顿不是激光的事，也是安全的事。

shots.scene: 干净的通道，地面扫得发亮
shots.prompt_en: A clean, freshly swept walkway in the workshop with a shiny floor. No people.
shots.narration: 通道要干净，经常打扫。

shots.scene: 软管和电缆挂在墙上的挂钩和线槽里
shots.prompt_en: Hoses and cables hang neatly on wall hooks and run inside cable trays above the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 软管、电缆挂起来，不躺在地上。

shots.scene: 家和办公室的图标，旁边一个车间图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a home and an office next to a workshop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 访客不熟悉车间，更要替他们想到。

shots.scene: 工作台边摞着几个废料桶，尖角从桶口伸出
shots.prompt_en: Several stacked buckets at the end of a workbench, with sharp metal scraps sticking out of the tops. No people.
shots.narration: 废料桶图方便，放在工作台边。

shots.scene: 一个边走边张望的人图标，腿碰到伸出的尖角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person looking around while walking, their leg bumping a sharp scrap edge. No people.
shots.narration: 边走边看的人，一碰就被扎伤。

shots.scene: 老李把废料压进桶里，把桶推到靠墙的位置
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing cut-resistant gloves, pushes scraps down into the bucket and moves it against the wall.
shots.narration: 废料不能伸出桶外，桶不挡道。

shots.scene: 折弯机和激光机上方画着声音波纹，人的视线都朝上
shots.prompt_en: Sound wave lines above a press brake and a laser cutting machine, with eye icons all looking up at them. No people.
shots.narration: 人的注意力，都在会响的机器上。

shots.scene: 脚下的线缆和废料图标旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a floor cable and scrap pieces at foot level with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 没人会低头看脚下，所以地上要清空。

shots.scene: 激光切割机的格栅工作台特写，一排排尖尖的支撑条
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a laser cutting table with rows of pointed metal support slats. No people.
shots.narration: 切割台的格栅条，又尖又利。

shots.scene: 手搭在格栅条上、人靠在机器上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand resting on the slats and a person leaning on the machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别靠在机器上，别把手搭上去。

shots.scene: 有人踩上切割台的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person climbing onto the slatted cutting table, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 更不能爬上切割台。

shots.scene: 示意：人在格栅上滑倒的图标，旁边一个急救箱
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a person slipping on the slatted table, next to a first aid kit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 曾有人摔在台面上，伤得很重。

shots.scene: 老李用专用工具从台外取件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reaches a part from outside the table using a long hook tool.
shots.narration: 取件、清渣，在台外用工具。

shots.scene: 角落里杂乱堆放的废料骨架
shots.prompt_en: Messy piles of laser-cut scrap skeleton sheets leaning in a corner. No people.
shots.narration: 废料管理难，一不留神就堆成山。

shots.scene: 大块废料骨架竖放在架子里，前面挂着链条
shots.prompt_en: Large scrap skeleton sheets stand upright in a rack with a chain hooked across the front. No people.
shots.narration: 大块废料竖放进架子，链条挂好。

shots.scene: 链条拉紧，废料板稳稳立着不倒
shots.prompt_en: The chain is pulled tight and the scrap sheets stay standing without tipping. No people.
shots.narration: 锁住了，它就倒不下来。

shots.scene: 架子上方一块板材的尖角伸出，正好在头部高度
shots.prompt_en: A sharp corner of a metal sheet sticks out from the top of a rack at exactly head height. No people.
shots.narration: 伸出来的板角，正好在头的高度。

shots.scene: 老李把伸出的板材收进架子，贴上空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes the protruding sheet back into the rack and adds a blank label.
shots.narration: 伸出来的要切掉或收好。

shots.scene: 地上画着黄色定位框，废料桶、推车各在框内
shots.prompt_en: Yellow floor outlines mark fixed spots, with a scrap bucket and a cart each inside its own box. No people.
shots.narration: 东西定点放，地上画好定位线。

shots.scene: 货架上的格子都贴着空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Shelves with each compartment marked by a blank label and a simple icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用完放回原处，一看就知道放哪。

shots.scene: 灭火器、配电箱、安全出口前堆着纸箱的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of cardboard boxes piled in front of a fire extinguisher, an electrical panel, and an emergency exit, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器、电箱、出口前，不准堆东西。

shots.scene: 清空后的安全出口和灭火器，地面有禁止堆放的斜线区
shots.prompt_en: A clear emergency exit and fire extinguisher with a striped keep-clear zone on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 疏散通道时刻畅通。

shots.scene: 纸箱、木托盘、油污抹布堆在激光机旁
shots.prompt_en: Cardboard boxes, wooden pallets and oily rags piled next to a laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 纸箱、木板、油抹布，遇火就着。

shots.scene: 小研把油污抹布放进带盖的金属桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student drops oily rags into a lidded metal can.
shots.narration: 油抹布放进带盖铁桶，及时清走。

shots.scene: 小研戴上防割手套，搬运带尖角的废料
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on cut-resistant gloves before carrying sharp-edged scrap.
shots.narration: 搬废料，戴防割手套。

shots.scene: 废金属分类放进不同的回收箱
shots.prompt_en: Scrap metal pieces are sorted into separate recycling bins. No people.
shots.narration: 废金属分类回收，不随手乱扔。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白检查表，在车间里逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks through the workshop with a blank checklist, ticking items.
shots.narration: 每天收工前，按清单查一遍。

shots.scene: 检查表图标：通道、线缆、废料、消防四项都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A checklist icon with four ticked items marked by walkway, cable, scrap, and fire extinguisher icons. No people.
shots.narration: 通道、线缆、废料、消防，都查到。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现通道、废料架、链条、灭火器、检查表五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five icons: a clear walkway, a scrap rack, a chain, a fire extinguisher, and a checklist.
shots.narration: 通道清、线缆起、废料锁。

shots.scene: 阿杰在整洁的车间里放好工具
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts tools back in their marked places in a tidy workshop.
shots.narration: 不靠不爬，定点放，天天查。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研、老李在整洁的车间里挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student, the female graduate student and the facility engineer in a tidy workshop.
shots.narration: 车间整洁，人人安全。
